subject: Heads up for Q1
text:
Renee,

We are in the middle of moving our banking relationship. I won't have numbers until the accounts are open in January, but I wanted to ask what you need from us so that your payments can go there from February on. Is there a form, or does someone need to call you?

Thanks,
Greg
label: change_request
note: No details yet; announces where payments will go and asks how to do it.
